what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from China in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7304 Chinese asylum seekers in Canada, 7.3% of all asylum seekers from China.
Refugees from China, a separate group, live mostly in India, the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over East Turkestan territory in China with ETIM in 2008, and an interstate armed conflict between China and India in 2020.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1230 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
